claim.statement: One-off jobs, cron schedules, deployment hooks (run_before) and task arrays run on a single durable lifecycle with retries (max_attempts default 4), per-attempt timeouts, quotas and admission shared with apps.

sources.quote: Every kind of job runs on one lifecycle: a one-off job, a cron

claim.measurable: relish apply a [job.X] with run_before = ["app.Y"]; the app is not published until the hook has an accepted successful outcome. A failing job retries up to max_attempts; overlap = "forbid" skips a cron occurrence while a run is active; a cron fire with no capacity is recorded as job-skipped, not dropped silently.
interfaces: [job.NAME] runtime, image, command, schedule, run_before, max_attempts, task_timeout_secs, overlap, replay_unknown
